instruction.text: Decide whether the statement is true or false.

atoms.a: Baby Boomers were born after World War II and experienced historical events such as the Civil Rights Movement and the Vietnam War.
Millennials grew up with widespread internet access and personal computers.
Generation Z has clear memories of life before smartphones and social media.

wrong.text: Generation Z grew up with smartphones, social media, and instant global connectivity.

atoms.a: Generation Alpha was born between 1997 and 2012.

wrong.text: Generation Alpha was born between 2013 and 2025.

atoms.a: Generation X is comfortable with both traditional and digital technology.
Every Baby Boomer has a conservative world view regarding family and career.

wrong.text: It is a stereotypical assumption that all Baby Boomers have a conservative world view.

atoms.a: It is important to distinguish between generational patterns and individual variations within a generation.
Applying generalised characteristics to all members of a generation is an accurate way to understand people.

wrong.text: Applying generalised characteristics to all members of a generation leads to stereotypical assumptions that aren't true for everyone.

atoms.a: It is possible for two people from the same generation to have completely different values and lifestyles.
Baby Boomers and Generation Z typically have similar views on climate change.

wrong.text: While Baby Boomers may not be that much invested in climate change, Generation Z suffers from climate anxiety.

atoms.a: Generation Z was shaped by the 9/11 attacks and the 2008 financial crisis.

wrong.text: Millennials were shaped by the 9/11 attacks and the 2008 financial crisis.

atoms.a: Conflicts between generations often arise because people apply stereotypical images instead of recognising individual traits.
Understanding individual traits can help reduce stereotypical thinking about generations.
A conservative world view is unique to Baby Boomers and has disappeared in younger generations.

wrong.text: Having a conservative world view is not exclusive among Baby Boomers.

atoms.a: The most accurate understanding of generations acknowledges both shared experiences and internal diversity.
